desc:
New update!

🤠Welcome to Westbound, an old fashioned cowboy action game! Live the life of a wanted outlaw, make it as a bounty hunter, or hunt and mine to earn your riches. Earn your fame and become a Legend of the Wild West!

🧥 We have a new avatar shop! Purchase 5 UGC items in game to earn Coyote Coins and the Mexican Short Sword. https://www.roblox.com/groups/4368670/Moondrop-Studios#!/store

Give us a like 👍 if you like the game!
